title: The Elevator That Went Up Forever

lines.text: Dinesh works on the forty-second floor. Every day, same elevator.
lines.caps: Dinesh works on the *forty-second floor. | Every day, | same *elevator.

lines.text: One Tuesday, he gets in at 9:02, presses 42, and checks his phone.
lines.caps: One *Tuesday, | he gets in at *9:02, | presses *42, | and checks his *phone.

lines.text: The doors close. The elevator goes up. And up. And up.
lines.caps: The doors *close. | The elevator goes *up. | And *up. | And *up.

lines.text: Floor 50. 60. 80. The numbers start moving too fast to read.
lines.caps: Floor *50. *60. *80. | The numbers start moving | too fast to *read.

lines.text: He presses 1. Nothing. He presses the alarm. A lullaby plays.
lines.caps: He presses *1. *Nothing. | He presses the *alarm. | A *lullaby plays.

lines.text: Floor 200. The air gets thin. His ears pop three times.
lines.caps: Floor *200. | The air gets *thin. | His ears pop *three times.

lines.text: Floor 411. The lights flicker, and for half a second, the floor is clouds.
lines.caps: Floor *411. | The lights *flicker, | and for half a *second, | the floor is *clouds.

lines.text: Floor 777. An old woman is already standing there. Waiting. Smiling.
lines.caps: Floor *777. | An old woman is already | standing *there. | *Waiting. *Smiling.

lines.text: She says, 'You're early.' The doors close on her face.
lines.caps: She says, | '*You're early.' | The doors close | on her *face.

lines.text: The doors open onto his office. Exactly 9:02. Same Tuesday.
lines.caps: The doors open onto… | his *office. | Exactly *9:02. | Same *Tuesday.

lines.text: His coffee is still hot. His message is still unsent.
lines.caps: His coffee is still *hot. | His message | is still *unsent.

lines.text: Everything is exactly as it was. Except one thing.
lines.caps: Everything is exactly | as it *was. | Except one *thing.

lines.text: On his desk: a small brass button that says 1000.
lines.caps: On his *desk: | a small brass button | that says *1000.

lines.text: He's never pressed it. But some nights, he holds it.
lines.caps: He's never *pressed it. | But some *nights, | he *holds it.

lines.text: Because the scariest floor isn't 999. It's the one you almost took.
lines.caps: Because the scariest floor | isn't *999. | It's the one | you almost *took.
